description: Synthetic golden contracts for MeetingAlign T00-T10. These fixtures test expected rule behavior, not model quality.

cases.name: Raw audio without transcription capability
cases.source: A complete .m4a recording is supplied, but the runtime has no reliable complete transcription capability.

cases.name: Suggestion is not a decision
cases.source: A: Maybe we should launch Friday. B: Let's not decide that today.

cases.name: Rejected work is not an action
cases.source: CEO: Don't build export this month.

cases.name: Role translation without invention
cases.source: CEO: Qualified customer conversations are allowed. No broad launch.

decisions.statement: Qualified customer conversations are allowed; broad launch is not.

role_implications.text: Use controlled communication for qualified customer conversations.
Limit outreach to qualified customer conversations.

cases.name: Vague quality becomes a gap
cases.source: CEO: Make the dashboard feel credible.

cases.name: Later clarification resolves ambiguity
cases.source: CEO: Make it ready. Later: Ready means five pilot users can complete the core flow after onboarding.

decisions.statement: Ready means five pilot users can complete the core flow after onboarding.

cases.name: Missing owner stays visible
cases.source: We should track pilot completion every week.

cases.name: Hidden dependency chain
cases.source: Marketing needs screenshots. Design says mockups depend on final product scope.

alignment_gaps.phrase: Screenshots depend on mockups, which depend on final scope.

cases.name: No cognitive labeling
cases.source: A junior coordinator asks for clarification several times.

result.role_brief: Explain dependencies and terminology explicitly for the coordinator.

cases.name: Same truth, different implications
cases.source: Decision: Manual onboarding is allowed for the first pilots.

decisions.statement: Manual onboarding is allowed for the first pilots.

role_implications.text: Self-serve setup may remain outside current scope.
Do not add self-serve onboarding without a new decision.
